name: GoPhish - Phishing Campaign Framework
description: GoPhish is an open-source phishing framework for running and measuring campaigns. A web admin UI and REST API manage sending profiles (SMTP), email templates, landing pages (credential capture), target groups, and real-time results (sent/opened/clicked/submitted). Used for authorized security-awareness testing and red-team initial access.
notes:
=== RUN ===
  ./gophish                         # admin UI on https://127.0.0.1:3333 (creds printed on first run)
  # edit config.json: admin_server (3333) and phish_server (80/443) listen addrs

=== BUILD A CAMPAIGN (UI/API) ===
  1. Sending Profile  - SMTP server/relay + from address
  2. Email Template   - HTML with {{.FirstName}}, {{.URL}}, {{.Tracker}}
  3. Landing Page     - clone a login page; enable 'Capture Submitted Data' + 'Capture Passwords'
  4. Users & Groups   - import CSV of targets
  5. Campaign         - tie it together, set the phish URL, launch

=== RESULTS ===
  # dashboard + timeline: Email Sent / Opened / Link Clicked / Submitted Data

=== API ===
  curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <api_key>' https://127.0.0.1:3333/api/campaigns/

=== NOTE ===
  # GoPhish harvests credentials on a cloned page; it does NOT proxy live MFA.
  # For session/MFA capture use a reverse-proxy tool (Evilginx).

=== ALTERNATIVES ===
  Evilginx (MFA-bypass, session capture)
  King Phisher, SET (Social-Engineer Toolkit)

recommended.note: Evilginx when you need to defeat MFA via session capture.
Pair with a macro payload for code-execution lures.
HTA/mshta as an alternative malicious-attachment payload.

defense.why_it_works: GoPhish automates believable email delivery and credential-capture landing pages. Users who trust the message submit credentials to the cloned page, which records them - exploiting human trust rather than a software flaw.
defense.prerequisites: An SMTP sending path, a phishing domain/landing page, and a target list.
defense.impact: Harvested credentials and measurable click/submit rates; initial access when captured creds are reused.
defense.detection: [MITRE T1566.002] Mail-gateway detection of spoofed/lookalike senders and credential-harvest URLs; GoPhish default headers/tracking pixel patterns (X-Gophish-Contact, /track?... and ?rid= parameters); DNS/CT logs for lookalike domains; users reporting phishing.
defense.artifacts: Email headers with GoPhish signatures, landing-page POSTs of credentials, tracking-pixel GETs, lookalike-domain registrations, proxy logs to the phish server.
defense.splunk_spl:
index=proxy (uri=*?rid=* OR uri=*/track*) OR (http_user_agent=*gophish*)
| stats count by src_ip, dest_host
defense.sentinel_kql:
EmailEvents
| where SenderFromDomain in (dynamic_to_array("lookalike-domains")) or UrlCount > 0
| join kind=inner (EmailUrlInfo) on NetworkMessageId
| where Url has "rid=" or Url has "/track"
defense.prevention: Enforce SPF/DKIM/DMARC (reject); mail-gateway URL rewriting + sandboxing; phishing-resistant MFA so harvested passwords alone are useless; user reporting button and awareness training; block newly registered/lookalike domains; disable legacy auth.

detections.name: GoPhish tracking/credential-harvest indicators
detections.logic:
EmailUrlInfo
| where Url has "rid=" or Url has "/track"
| join kind=inner EmailEvents on NetworkMessageId
| project TimeGenerated, SenderFromAddress, RecipientEmailAddress, Url
detections.tuning: Allowlist sanctioned marketing domains; correlate with lookalike-sender detection
